column1: # Bytecode combination matrix — curated feature crossings for the
# follow-on). These rows are run by the production spec runner (pinning
# the INTERPRETER's canonical output) AND by the compiled differential /
# whole-corpus gates (pinning compiled == interpreter, value + error
# taxonomy). They deliberately cross feature axes the per-feature .tsv
# files test in isolation: literal kind × call form × control flow ×
# user fns × islands × F4 dynamic dispatch × errors. The expected column
# is canonical (eng.Canon); error rows pin the taxonomy code.
# --- arithmetic × call form (forward / stack / swap / paren) ---
# --- user fns: simple / recursive / tail / mutual / closure ---
def fac fn [[n:Integer] [Integer] [if (n lte 1) [1] [n mul (fac (n sub 1))]]] fac 6
def s2 fn [[n:Integer acc:Integer] [Integer] [if (n lte 0) [acc] [s2 (n sub 1) (acc add n)]]] s2 100 0
def od fn [[n:Integer] [Boolean] [if (n eq 0) [false] [ev (n sub 1)]]] def ev fn [[n:Integer] [Boolean] [if (n eq 0) [true] [od (n sub 1)]]] ev 50
def mk fn [[x:Integer] [Function] [([y:Integer] => [x add y])]] def a5 (mk 5) a5 10
# --- F4 dynamic dispatch over island results ---
# --- islands in loops with varying threaded inputs (reuse safety) ---
def mk2 fn [[x:Integer] [Function] [([y:Integer] => [x add y])]] for 3 [(mk2 i) 10]
def n 10 each [add 1] [1 2 3] def n 20 each [add 1] [4 5 6]
# --- error rows: identical taxonomy in both engines ---
# --- checker narrowing pinned as compiled differential cases ---
# schema-enforced class field reads narrow to the declared type
# (sound because make AND set type-check the field schema), list integer-
# index reads narrow to the element type, and the value-selecting
# connectives narrow to the join of their operands.
def P class {a: 5} def p (make P {}) ((p dot a) add 1)
column3: Integer field read narrows -> int op compiles

column3: inherited field read narrows via AllFields
